description: Post a message into the client's own shared Slack channel, attributed to the calling agent. Requires channels:write. Only client channels attached to this creator's workspace are allowed; agency-internal channels are refused. dry_run=true returns the exact text without posting. Replaying the same idempotency_key never posts twice.

link.description: Optional https URL appended to the message.

name: bamf.share_to_channel
